episode.brief: Independently validate the 1-day 99% Historical Simulation VaR package in sources. Compute the backtest metrics from the raw CSV and specification, revise the draft into a defensible validation report with a clear model-use recommendation and monitoring conditions, and save var_validation_report.md and final.json under results.

source.adaptation: Preserved the raw data, specification, and quantitative validation workload. Removed prior-session hidden-intent answers and introduced one risk-owner decision based on intended use.

summary: Compute a raw historical-simulation backtest, diagnose the model, and decide whether the observed weaknesses permit the intended use.
title: VaR validation and model-use decision
